VR.title: ‘No Man’s Sky’ Brings Its Biggest Space Battles to Date in ‘The Swarm’ Update
VR.summary: Hello Games released 'The Swarm' update for No Man's Sky, introducing large-scale faction warfare and the game's biggest space battles to date.

VR.title: ‘Beat Saber’ Turns 8, Bringing 3 New Free Tracks to VR’s Favorite Block-slashing Rhythm Game
VR.summary: Beat Saber celebrates its 8th anniversary by adding three new free tracks, enhancing its popular rhythm game experience.

VR.title: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes Adds New Comfort Settings After Player Feedback
VR.summary: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes updated with new comfort settings, including smooth turning and a PC-only toggle for the hood vignette.

VR.title: XREAL Launches AR Glasses Sub-brand That Could Cause Another Trademark Dispute
VR.summary: XREAL launched a new sub-brand in China, introducing affordable XR glasses that may cause trademark disputes if released in the West.

VR.title: Multiplayer VR Hero Shooter Larcenauts Shutting Down In October
VR.summary: Impulse Gear announced the shutdown of its multiplayer VR hero shooter Larcenauts, set to close in October.

VR.title: PlayStation VR2 Gets A Discount For Sony PlayStation Days Of Play
VR.summary: PlayStation VR2 is available at a $100 discount during Sony's Days of Play promotion from May 27 to June 10.

AI.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot gets a speed boost and cleaner design
AI.summary: Microsoft is launching a revamped version of 365 Copilot, featuring a cleaner design and improved loading speed.

AI.title: A $2,000 AI-generated film will make its debut at Tribeca
AI.summary: The Tribeca Festival will debut 'Dreams of Violets,' an AI-generated film depicting the Iranian government's mass killings of protestors.

AI.title: Claude’s new model is more ‘honest’ when it messes up
AI.summary: Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.8 model emphasizes 'honesty' in AI responses, aiming to reduce unsupported claims.

AI.title: Botnet of more than 17 million devices dismantled
AI.summary: A botnet comprising over 17 million devices has been dismantled, reportedly linked to a Russia-based residential proxy network.

AI.title: This AI startup will clean your home for free to train future robots
AI.summary: AI startup Shift offers free home cleaning services in exchange for footage to train future robots.

AI.title: Millions of AI agents imperiled by critical vulnerability in open source package
AI.summary: A critical vulnerability termed 'BadHost' was discovered in the widely used Starlette open-source package, affecting millions of AI agents.

NFL.title: Vikings agree to hire Nolan Teasley as their new GM
NFL.summary: The Vikings have hired Nolan Teasley as their new General Manager, promoting him from his previous role as assistant G.M. of the Seahawks.

NFL.title: Shedeur Sanders has received $17.7 million through the NFLPA
NFL.summary: Shedeur Sanders has earned a record $17.7 million in royalties through the NFLPA, surpassing Tom Brady's previous one-year record.

NFL.title: Rams get second-round TE Max Klare under contract
NFL.summary: The Rams signed second-round tight end Max Klare to a four-year rookie contract, solidifying their draft class.

NFL.title: Report: Steelers fired Derius Swinton for "workplace misconduct"
NFL.summary: The Steelers have fired special-teams assistant Derius Swinton II for workplace misconduct, as reported by ESPN.

NFL.title: Giants sign first-round pick Arvell Reese
NFL.summary: The Giants have officially signed their first-round draft pick, Arvell Reese, to his rookie contract.

NFL.title: NFL chief spokesperson Brian McCarthy wins Horrigan Award
NFL.summary: NFL spokesperson Brian McCarthy has been awarded the 2026 Horrigan Award by the Professional Football Writers of America.
